is_anopheles.evidence: Studies Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M form) collected in Adzope, Cote d'Ivoire (page 1, Abstract).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assayed the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr-w mutation using allele-specific PCR (page 2, Molecular assays; page 4, Table 2).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 2 (page 4) provides exact SS, RS, and RR genotype counts and allele frequencies for L1014F for Port-Bouet (N=56) and Tsassodji (N=34), split by alive/dead phenotypes.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquito larvae were collected from breeding sites in Port-Bouet and Tsassodji (Adzope district, Eastern Cote d'Ivoire) between May and June 2007 and reared to adults (page 2, Methods).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field collection, bioassay, and genotyping study.

sub_country_location.evidence: Sampling sites specified at sub-district level: Port-Bouet (6 deg 10 N, 3 deg 85 W) and Tsassodji in Adzope city, Eastern Cote d'Ivoire (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections took place between May and June 2007 (page 2, Pyrethroid susceptibility tests).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Primary empirical research reporting original field collections in Adzope in 2007.

supplement.evidence: All bioassay results and marker genotype counts are fully reported in Table 1 and Table 2 in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated pyrethroid resistance and Vgsc L1014F (L995F) kdr frequencies in Anopheles gambiae s.s. (M form) from two sites in Adzope, Eastern Cote d'Ivoire, collected in May-June 2007. Genotype counts for L1014F were scored separately for bioassay survivors and dead mosquitoes.
